question_text: Across all crowd-mode cameras (ExpoFloor_MainAisle, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, DemoBooth_Intel, KeynoteHall_Stage, FoodCourt_North) on 2025-12-08 (UTC), which location showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast — meaning the largest ratio of its peak head_count to its overnight quiet-hour average head_count? Identify the camera_location and explain the ratio order of magnitude.
answer_text: KeynoteHall_Stage had the most extreme contrast: peak head_count 500 vs overnight quiet-hour average 7.085, yielding a peak-to-baseline ratio of 70.57163020465772. The ratio is on the order of 10^1 (tens), roughly 7×10^1.

citations.cypher:
WITH ['ExpoFloor_MainAisle','DemoBooth_NVIDIA','DemoBooth_Intel','KeynoteHall_Stage','FoodCourt_North'] AS locs
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch.camera_location IN locs
  AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH
  ch.camera_location AS camera_location,
  max(ch.peak_hc) AS day_peak,
  avg(CASE WHEN ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T06:00:00Z' THEN ch.avg_hc END) AS overnight_avg
WITH
  camera_location,
  day_peak,
  overnight_avg,
  CASE WHEN overnight_avg IS NULL OR overnight_avg = 0 THEN null ELSE toFloat(day_peak) / overnight_avg END AS ratio
WITH
  collect({camera_location: camera_location, day_peak: day_peak, overnight_avg: overnight_avg, ratio: ratio}) AS rows,
  max(ratio) AS max_ratio
UNWIND rows AS r
RETURN
  r.camera_location AS camera_location,
  r.day_peak AS day_peak_hc,
  r.overnight_avg AS overnight_quiet_avg_hc,
  r.ratio AS peak_to_baseline_ratio,
  CASE WHEN r.ratio IS NULL OR r.ratio <= 0 THEN null ELSE toInteger(floor(log10(r.ratio))) END AS ratio_order_of_magnitude_power,
  CASE WHEN r.ratio IS NULL OR r.ratio <= 0 THEN null ELSE '10^' + toString(toInteger(floor(log10(r.ratio)))) END AS ratio_order_of_magnitude_label,
  (r.ratio = max_ratio) AS is_top_location
ORDER BY coalesce(r.ratio, -1) DESC
